Assignment: Module 10 (Consolidation)

Overview: You will create and resolve a Git merge conflict in one of your own TEI files, then validate every TEI file in your project so the edition is clean before the final modules.

Class time is work time. Read the lessons before class; the Friday session is for running the passes and building your merged file, so most of this assignment can be finished in the room.

Deadline: due Friday, November 13, by 11:00 PM.
